SELECT co.charge_id as chargeId, co.user_id as userId, co.mobile as mobile, co.channel as channel, co.platform as platform, '' as sourcetypeName, co.orderno as orderno, co.threeorder_no as threeorderNo, co.amount as amount, co.real_amount as realAmount, co.state as state, DATE_FORMAT(co.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as chargeTime, DATE_FORMAT(co.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime, co.oper_code as operCode, co.remark as remark, co.info_ip as infoIp, agent_user.username as agentName, co.agent as agent, co.salesmanid as salesmanid, salesman_user.username as salesmanName, u.invite_code_status as inviteCodeStatus, u.liebian as liebian, DATE_FORMAT(u.create_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as usercreateTime, CASE WHEN co.state = 1 THEN CAST(co.amount AS CHAR) ELSE '0' END as successcz, CASE WHEN co.state = 1 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END as successcnt, co.channelid as channelid, co.merchantid as merchantid, co.merchantname as merchantname, co.uamout as uamout, co.uprice as uprice, co.channel_type as channelType, co.u_real_amout as uRealAmout, co.wallet_id as walletId, co.wallet_addr as walletAddr FROM tb_charge_order co LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON co.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_user agent_user ON u.agent = agent_user.id LEFT JOIN sys_user salesman_user ON u.salesmanid = salesman_user.id
AND u.agent = #{params.currentUserId}
AND u.salesmanid = #{params.currentUserId}
AND u.biaoqian = #{params.biaoqian}
AND co.biaoqian IS NOT NULL
AND co.biaoqian IS NULL
AND co.create_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{params.createstarttime}/1000)
AND co.create_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{params.createendtime}/1000)
AND co.create_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{params.startTime}/1000)
AND co.create_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{params.endTime}/1000)
AND co.orderno = #{params.orderno}
AND co.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.mobile}, '%')
AND co.state = #{params.state}
AND co.threeorder_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.threeorder_no}, '%')
ORDER BY ${params.orderField} DESC
ORDER BY ${params.orderField} ASC
ORDER BY co.create_time DESC
